title: GAX-P07 - FHIR interoperable read-only decision layer
outcome: Create a deterministic, version-aware, read-only FHIR representation and adapter layer that reuses GAXBench decision/calibration/selective-risk contracts without claiming clinical execution authority or FHIR conformance certification.
rationale: FHIR support can be misleading if a model wins by serialization artifacts, silently mixes FHIR releases, or turns tool routing into EHR write authority. P07 freezes a published R5 reference, preserves source-native R4 identity for compatible benchmarks, enforces read-only actions, and qualifies local-export adapters without paid-cloud dependence.
scope_in: HL7 FHIR R5 5.0.0 canonical published-reference freeze
Explicit R4 source-native compatibility metadata without semantic conversion claim
Deterministic strict-JSON FHIR resource and Bundle rendering
Narrative-included, source-order JSON, and deterministic flat-text representation controls
Read-only FHIR action schema for resource selection, read/search routing, sufficiency, abstention, and support verification
FHIR decision-case conversion into canonical GAXBench BenchmarkItem contracts
Frozen MedAgentBench source identity and local-export adapter protocol
Frozen FHIR-AgentBench source identity, R4 preservation, and local-export adapter protocol
Final-test rejection during P07 adapter/representation qualification
Synthetic CC0 interoperability fixtures and data registry
scope_out: No POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, or model-selected EHR write operations
No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, treatment, triage, or emergency execution
No claim that deterministic rendering is full HL7 FHIR validation
No silent R4 to R5 semantic conversion
No MIMIC-derived data redistribution without source-term review
No externally restricted MedAgentBench reference solution redistribution
No final-test tuning or representation selection
No FHIR benchmark superiority claim from synthetic fixtures
acceptance: The P07 standards registry identifies FHIR R5 5.0.0 as the canonical published reference and records R6 snapshot/ballot exclusion
FHIR resources require a non-empty resourceType and strict finite JSON values
Bundle entry resources are recursively checked for resourceType when present
Canonical structured rendering sorts object keys while preserving array order
FHIR narrative text is excluded by default and only included through an explicit representation control
Source-order JSON and deterministic flat-text controls are available beside canonical rendering
FHIRReadOnlyAction cannot represent write action kinds and rejects explicit POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE query methods
Retrieval actions require an explicit resource_type
FHIRDecisionCase preserves source FHIR version, allowed actions, sufficiency target, gold routing action, and provenance
Conversion into BenchmarkItem preserves explicit source FHIR version and representation revision in model-visible state
FHIR-AgentBench local exports must retain R4 identity and the frozen upstream revision
MedAgentBench local exports must retain the frozen upstream revision
P07 external-export loading rejects final-test rows unless a future P08 caller explicitly enables final evaluation
Benchmark repository licenses are tracked separately from external dataset/reference-artifact terms
P07 tests and registry use only abstract CC0 synthetic content with no PHI, medical thresholds, diagnosis rules, or treatment guidance
Exact-head CI passes Ruff, mypy strict, pytest, and compileall on Python 3.11/3.12 across Linux and Windows
Implementation merges with an expected-head guard, post-main CI succeeds, and a separate canonical closeout is required before SG-000010 becomes PROVEN

risk.recovery: Revert P07 files and return to canonical P06 main 54c4adde31e271004904670426a9472a279a3f98. No real clinical data, EHR write capability, released clinical model, or production behavior is affected.

minimality.rationale: The smallest defensible P07 surface freezes version identity, deterministic representation, read-only actions, and benchmark-local export adapters before any real EHR-agent performance experiment.

requirements: Never expose model-selected EHR write operations in P07.
Never relabel R4 benchmark data as R5.
Never equate FHIR formatting with clinical correctness or conformance certification.
Never redistribute PHI, MIMIC-derived content, or restricted reference artifacts without explicit rights.
Never use final-test labels for P07 representation or adapter repair.

unresolved_decisions: Paper-level FHIR representation gains remain unclaimed until P08 matched real-benchmark evaluation.
MedAgentBench runtime FHIR release is not inferred when upstream documentation does not freeze it; exported tasks must declare their source version explicitly.
R4/R5 semantic conversion is deferred; P07 only preserves explicit source identity and deterministic rendering.
Any future write-action research requires a separate safety-governed phase and is not implied by P07.
